episodeTitle.en: The nature of product | Marty Cagan, Silicon Valley Product Group
episodeTitle.zh: 产品之道 | 硅谷产品集团的马蒂·卡根

guestBioOfficial.en: How do you maintain your product mojo? What are common diseases of product teams, and how do you avoid them? Why should you focus less on problem discovery and more on solution discovery? After working as a product leader for over 20 years, Marty Cagan started Silicon Valley Product Group to help product teams operate at a higher level. In this conversation, Marty shares what Steve Jobs can teach you about building product, how to structure your teams for innovation, how to improve your product culture, which trends in PM to ignore, and much more. After this, you'll never think about building teams the same way. Join us.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 如何保持产品灵感？产品团队常见的“病症”及应对之道？为何应更注重解决方案的探索而非问题发现？拥有20余年产品领导经验的马蒂·卡根创立了硅谷产品集团，致力于助力产品团队提升运营水平。在本次对谈中，马蒂将分享史蒂夫·乔布斯在产品打造方面的启示、创新型团队的构建方法、产品文化的优化策略、产品管理需忽视的潮流趋势等诸多观点。听完这场对谈，您将重新审视团队组建之道。欢迎加入。

title.en: The nature of product | Marty Cagan, Silicon Valley Product Group
title.zh: 产品之道 | 硅谷产品集团的马蒂·卡根

summary.en: Marty discusses the principles of strong product organizations, including empowered, cross-functional teams and the importance of real product strategy. He shares how the best companies separate discovery from delivery and invest in continuous learning. The episode distills decades of coaching the world's top product teams into core lessons.
summary.zh: 马蒂探讨了强大产品组织的原则，包括被赋能的跨职能团队，以及真正的产品战略的重要性。他分享了顶尖公司如何把"探索"与"交付"分开，并持续投入学习。本期将他辅导全球顶级产品团队数十年的经验，提炼为核心要点。
